data.name: ActivityPubExtension4AgenticDelegation.and.HITL.Verification
data.description: As autonomous AI agents increasingly interact with social networks, distinguishing between purely automated bot spam and authorized, agent-drafted but human-approved content is critical. This FEP proposes an extension to the ActivityStreams Create and Note objects to include standardized metadata for "Agentic Delegation." It introduces a generator and approvalGate property to explicitly declare when a payload was constructed by an LLM or multi-agent system but cryptographically or explicitly authorized by a human principal (Human-in-the-Loop). This allows Fediverse instances to filter, badge, or federate agent-assisted content securely without resorting to blanket bot bans, preserving server health while enabling next-generation omnichannel automation.
